gate_definitions.patch_coverage: >= 80% of new executable src lines covered
gate_definitions.analyzers_high_severity: new unsuppressed SARIF results with level=error or category Security, fingerprint=(ruleId, file, normalised message), line numbers ignored
gate_definitions.units: coverage line_rate/branch_rate are fractions 0-1; patch_coverage pct/wilson_low/wilson_high/branch_pct are percentages 0-100 (Wilson score interval, z=1.96)

coverage.tool: Microsoft.CodeCoverage 17.12 (dotnet test --collect "Code Coverage;Format=cobertura" --settings lab.runsettings); per-project reports merged by analyze.py (line union exact, branch union = lower bound)

incomplete.reason: ExecutionTests, MapModeExecutionTests and GeneratedCode.Tests run the source generator inside csc at build time; that execution is not instrumented. Generator coverage comes only from MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests (in-process Roslyn test harness).
MessagePack.Tests also targets net472 on Windows only, and the Unity test suites (src/MessagePack.UnityClient) need the Unity editor; neither can run on macOS. Only net8.0 test targets were run.

SARIF covers src/MessagePack (netstandard2.0, netstandard2.1, net8.0, net472) plus its project references MessagePack.Annotations, MessagePack.SourceGenerator, MessagePack.Analyzers, MessagePack.Analyzers.CodeFixes. ImmutableCollection, ReactiveProperty, AspNetCoreMvcFormatter, Experimental, UnityShims and SourceGenerator.Unity were not analysed (no PR touches them).
Branch rates of the merged report are a lower bound: Cobertura gives covered/valid counts per line, not which arms, so the union across test projects takes the max per line. Line union is exact.
Changes to T4 sources (*.tt) are not compiled; they are measured through the checked-in preprocessed *.cs templates that the diff also changes.
Each test project was run once per ref; flakiness was not measured. Line hits on unchanged MessagePack code vary by up to 7 of 17,647 lines between refs, which bounds run-to-run noise.
